name: greek-fuel-prices
title: Greek fuel prices by prefecture, daily
description: Daily average pump prices for every Greek prefecture since March 2017, read from the Ministry of Development's daily bulletins, with Greek refinery prices, the EU Weekly Oil Bulletin for comparison, and a model of how pump prices follow them. Updated every day.

resources.name: transcribed
resources.description: Days no parser can read, typed in by hand from the bulletin's page image: twelve scanned bulletins of July-August 2020 and one with a broken text layout (27 March 2017). Each was checked against a machine reading of the page (OCR, or for 2017-03-27 the PDF's own text layer, which it matches cell for cell), against the neighbouring days, and against the national average rebuilt from the prefecture prices for unleaded 95, 100 and diesel; the rows also appear in the yearly pump files.

resources.name: eu_weekly_oil_bulletin
resources.description: Weekly consumer prices in every EU country with and without taxes, since January 2005, as published by the European Commission in its Weekly Oil Bulletin. Changes made here: prices converted from EUR per 1,000 litres to EUR per litre; four of the six fuels kept (Euro-super 95, road diesel, heating gas oil, LPG; the two fuel oil grades left out); reshaped to one row per week, country and fuel, leaving out weeks a country reported nothing for that fuel. The taxes are the difference between the two prices.

sources.title: European Commission, DG Energy, Weekly Oil Bulletin, price history (© European Union, CC BY 4.0)

resources.description: Expected change of the pump price 7 and 14 days after the latest bulletin per area and fuel (EUR/L), with the model's backtest record since 2024: mean absolute error (mae_*), the error of assuming no change (mae_naive_*), and the share of days the direction was right (hit_*) and the share a 'same as last week' guess got right (hit_momentum_*).
